title: Standing Idle Rate for Long-Standing Autopay Households — Parking License EV Charging
content:
Note to the EV idle rates of the Parking License: the standing idle rate — the hourly figure on which the rate for billed idle hours rests — follows the standing of the Apartment Home Lease the license belongs to, read from that lease's autopay enrollment and move-in date.

## Rate note

When the lease the license belongs to is enrolled in autopay and its move-in date is at least 1461 days before the handling date, the standing idle rate is $8.00 per hour; when that lease is enrolled in autopay and its move-in date is at least 365 but fewer than 1461 days before the handling date, the standing idle rate is $10.00 per hour; in every other case the standing idle rate is the product's idle fee per hour.

## By autopay enrollment and move-in date

| Apartment Home Lease enrolled in autopay | Days from the lease's move-in date to the handling date | Standing idle rate |
|---|---|---|
| yes | 1461 or more | $8.00 per hour |
| yes | 365 to 1460 | $10.00 per hour |
| yes | fewer than 365 | the product's idle fee per hour |
| no | any | the product's idle fee per hour |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical leases, all enrolled in autopay)

- Move-in 1461 days before the handling date: at least 1461 — $8.00.
- Move-in 1460 days before: fewer than 1461 but at least 365 — $10.00.
- Move-in 365 days before: at least 365 — $10.00.
- Move-in 364 days before: fewer than 365 — the product's idle fee per hour.

A lease that is not enrolled in autopay takes the product's idle fee per hour however long ago its move-in date was.
